messages:
Erin: Customer reported redeem flow returns success but org balance unchanged. Org: org_7362, billing_account: ba_902, redeem_id: claim_8f3a, promo: SPRING25. UI + email show accepted. Customer provided tx id tx_7891 and screenshot. Can we triage?
Maya: Thanks — can you paste the webhook payload or the checkout response? also need timestamps.
billing-bot: delivered webhook POST /ledger/events 200 OK at 2025-07-02T14:03:22Z, request_id rq_5a1c, idempotency_key: claim_8f3a, response_status: 200
Erin: Pasting payload (sanitized):
```
{
  "redeem_id": "claim_8f3a",
  "org_id": "org_7362",
  "billing_profile_id": null,
  "subaccount_id": "sub_999",
  "amount_cents": 5000,
  "currency": "USD",
  "source": "webflow",
  "timestamp": "2025-07-02T14:03:21Z"
}
```
Devon: quick read — billing_profile_id is null and subaccount_id present. Our ledger routing prefers billing_profile_id; if null we fall back to subaccount mapping which can route to an internal test account. this smells like a mapping bug.
Maya: I checked ledger: no entry for org_7362 or ba_902 for that timestamp. there IS a credit posted to account sub_999 (inactive test account) at 2025-07-02T14:03:22Z, id tx_9876.
Erin: Oh — customer reports they never had sub_999. looks like webflow connector sent subaccount instead of billing_profile.
Devon: probable cause: the webflow->claims adapter populates `subaccount_id` from session metadata when billing_profile is absent. for new SSO flows the billing_profile should be set. patch idea: treat subaccount_id as secondary only if it maps to an active billing_profile.
ops-trevor: we can do a manual migration for this customer: create a ledger reversal on sub_999 and reapply to org_7362. need approval and an ops runbook.
Maya: please include the original webhook payload and the tx id so finance can audit. I'll open a billing-corr ticket.
Erin: Sent customer a short update: "we see the credit routed to an internal subaccount; we're initiating a manual correction and will confirm ETA shortly." :thumbsup:
Devon: short-term fix pushed to eng-billing backlog. proposed immediate mitigation: update adapter to supply billing_profile_id when present in user acct, and add guard to reject ambiguous payloads (raise 400) so UI doesn't show a false success.
Maya: I'll coordinate the ledger migration and tag finance & legal for audit. action items: (1) ops runbook for manual migration, (2) fix adapter mapping, (3) add guard / monitoring for future ambiguous claims.
Erin: thanks all — I'll keep the thread updated and post the manual migration ticket id when created.
